published.source: DPS report 2026-10-28 (full re-sim at 20,000 iterations, 180 s, after the launch-realm hunter hotfix)

summary: The twist build with its side points in Holy instead of Protection. Twists Seal of Righteousness to Seal of Command. The class default, 4.0 DPS ahead of Ret twist at 180s.
rotation: Pre-pull: Seal of Command at -3s, then Seal of Righteousness at -1.5s, so the first swing gets the Echo
Hammer of Wrath under 20% boss health, before Consecration
Judgement on cooldown on whichever damage seal is up
Seal of Righteousness whenever no damage seal is up

Twist: with Seal of Righteousness up, switch to Seal of Command in the last 1.5s before a swing, then back to Righteousness before the next. One switch per swing, at any mana. Twist of Light's Echo applies the old seal on the next swing
Racials, Goblin Sapper, Dragonfire Potion and Demonic Rune on free GCDs
consumes: Elixir of Greater Firepower (Forever's Holy Power elixir)
caveats: Takes Pursuit of Justice 2 (movement speed), a must-have talent. It costs nothing here, because it replaced Purifying Power, which does nothing on this boss.
5 DPS ahead of Ret twist at 120s, 4.0 at 180s and 8 at 300s. Ret twist's Precision puts its hit over the 8% cap.
Purifying Power does nothing on the generic boss.
Unverified: Holy Strike's flat bonus is added before its weapon damage percent, as the client data says.
The top Holy Strike and Consecration ranks may be out of date (about 1.2% of DPS).

Seal of Righteousness adds 12% of spell power per hit with a two-hander, counted once, as its tooltip says (spell 70425). Counted twice, DPS would be 46-51 higher. At the proc spell's 0%, it would be 53-59 lower.
Two-Handed Weapon Specialization boosts Holy seal damage, as in the Era sim. The client says Physical only. Without it, DPS is 11 lower.
No filler explosive, because each 1s cast resets the swing. The Goblin Land Mine and EZ-Thro Dark Bomb cost 4.9 DPS at 180s, and the EZ-Thro Thorium Grenade 5.7.
notes: mksettings writes primarySeal Righteousness; set to Command to match the shipped preset's options (the APL never uses Cast Primary Seal, so DPS is unaffected). Undead since the 2026-10-27 race re-pick (the race sweep with each race's own rotation and gear, standards 29), was Human. The raid's Sunder Armor ramps since 2026-10-31 (standard 32, mksettings -sunder ramp): a warrior tank stacks it from the pull and one DPS warrior casts it on its first GCD.
